The Node.js **22.0.0** GitHub release is here: [github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0).

1. **GitHub release (primary)** — [v22.0.0](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0): published 24 Apr 2024 by RafaelGSS (with marco-ippolito), tag `v22.0.0`, signed. Highlights: `require()` of ESM graphs, WebSocket client, V8 updates. Status at release: Current (LTS planned for October). [[1]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0)

2. **Release blog source (nodejs.org repo)** — [v22.0.0.md](https://github.com/nodejs/nodejs.org/blob/main/apps/site/pages/en/blog/release/v22.0.0.md): title “Node.js 22.0.0 (Current)”, author Rafael Gonzaga, date 2024-04-24. Notes include dropping import assertions, stable `watch`, V8 12.4.254.14, WebSocket enabled by default. [[2]](https://github.com/nodejs/nodejs.org/blob/main/apps/site/pages/en/blog/release/v22.0.0.md)

3. **Announcement post** — [Node.js 22 is now available!](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/announcements/v22-release-announce): V8 12.4 (Wasm GC, `Array.fromAsync`, Set methods, iterator helpers); experimental `--experimental-require-module` for synchronous ESM. Points to the full release post and downloads. [[3]](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/announcements/v22-release-announce)

4. **Binary index** — [nodejs.org/download/release/v22.0.0/](https://nodejs.org/download/release/v22.0.0/): installers and archives (Windows, macOS, Linux, source) plus `SHASUMS256.txt`. [[4]](https://nodejs.org/download/release/v22.0.0)

5. **Changelog file** — [CHANGELOG_V22.md](https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/changelogs/CHANGELOG_V22.md): Node.js 22 history starting at 22.0.0 (codename Jod for the line). [[5]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/changelogs/CHANGELOG_V22.md)

6. **Release commit** — [nodejs/node@ae61a08](https://github.com/nodejs/node/commit/ae61a08fae115853580d5ea1ee12caaa8c10fce5): “2024-04-23, Version 22.0.0 (Current)”, semver-major notes and changelog index update. [[6]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/commit/ae61a08fae115853580d5ea1ee12caaa8c10fce5)

7. **All releases index** — [github.com/nodejs/node/releases](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases): GitHub releases list; 22.0.0 is an older tag (later 22.x LTS notes appear on later pages). [[7]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases?page=3)

8. **Tags list** — [github.com/nodejs/node/tags](https://github.com/nodejs/node/tags): signed release tags for the repo, including the 22 line. [[8]](https://github.com/nodejs/node/tags)
